learning_outcomes.text: Ability to understand basic concepts of sensing, measurement and A/D conversion.
Ability to interface sensors to microcontrollers or computers.
Ability to make communication between sensors, actuators and computers in a basic level.
Ability to choose the right microcontroller and programming technique to complete an aimed project.
Familiarity to the principles of actuation.
Ability to understand and deal with signal and signal processing in a basic level.
Ability to have enough knowledge for achieving microcontroller programming using C and doing simulations using Matlab/Simulink.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to C programming in a basic level.
Hardware and Software and their relations with computers.
Introduction to basic electric circuit components.
Basic level electric circuit components and the usage of circuit board.
Communication between microcontroller and Matlab and development an user interface.
Working with a real mechatronics system using the knowledge gained through out the semester.
bibliography: Sabri Çetinkunt, Mechatronics, John Wiley & Sons, 2006, ISBN-047147987X.
Christopher T. Kilian, Modern Control Technology: Components and Systems, Delmar Thomson Learning; 2 ed. 2007, ISBN-10: 076682358X.
